notes: Doctoral admission is by application to each faculty's doctoral committee through the Promovendus portal, so there is no university-wide application form or fee. The EUR 361 (winter 2026/27) semester fee applies only after acceptance, at enrolment. The School of Science regulations cover mathematics, chemistry, biology and physics; computer science, electrical and computer engineering, mechanical engineering, civil engineering and environmental sciences publish their own doctoral regulations.
